title: Earned Premium and Return Terms of the BizFlood Program
content:
Each tier of BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) fixes the share of the term premium that is fully earned at binding, whether the policy fee and inspection fees are returned on cancellation, whether the surplus lines tax and stamping fee are returned with returned premium, and the credit method when a location is deleted mid-term.

## Terms

| Tier | Share of term premium fully earned at binding (percent) | Policy fee and inspection fees returned on cancellation | Surplus lines tax and stamping fee returned with returned premium | Credit method for a location deleted mid-term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 25 | No | Yes | Pro rata |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 25 | No | Yes | Pro rata |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 25 | No | Yes | Pro rata |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 25 | No | Yes | Pro rata |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 25 | No | Yes | Pro rata |
| BizFlood Large Property | 25 | No | Yes | Pro rata |

## In brief

- On every tier 25 percent of the term premium is fully earned at binding.
- On every tier the policy fee and inspection fees are not returned on cancellation.
- On every tier the surplus lines tax and stamping fee go back with any returned premium.
- On every tier a location deleted mid-term is credited pro rata.

## Illustration (hypothetical premium)

For a hypothetical term premium of 8,000, the share fully earned at binding is 25 percent of 8,000, that is 2,000.
